title: Accidental Loss and Damage Coverage
text: The insurer will indemnify the policyholder against sudden, accidental loss or damage to the insured vehicle caused by collision, overturning, or external violent impact during the policy period.
conditions: Vehicle must be used within geographical boundaries specified in policy schedule.
Damage must arise from an active accidental impact.

title: Theft and Total Burglary Coverage
text: In the event of total theft or burglary of the insured vehicle, the insurer will pay the Insured Declared Value (IDV) minus applicable deductible, provided prompt notification and police FIR are submitted.
conditions: Ignition keys must not have been negligently left inside unattended vehicle.
Immediate notification within 48 hours to police and insurer.

title: Fire, Explosion, and Lightning Damage
text: Direct loss or damage caused by fire, spontaneous combustion, self-ignition, lightning, or explosion is covered under own-damage coverage.
conditions: Fire must not result from illegal performance modifications or electrical overloading.
supporting_evidence_requirements: Fire Brigade Report or Police General Diary Entry

title: Natural Calamities and Disasters
text: Damage resulting from flood, typhoon, hurricane, storm, tempest, inundation, cyclone, earthquake, or landslide is indemnified subject to policy limits.
conditions: Engine hydrostatic lock caused by restarting engine in deep water is excluded unless hydro-lock add-on cover is active.
supporting_evidence_requirements: Repair Estimate noting flood/water line height

title: Third-Party Liability Exclusions
text: Own-damage claims do not cover liability incurred to third-party property or persons unless specifically processed under Section III (Third-Party Legal Liability).
conditions: Claims for damage to policyholder's own vehicle cannot include third-party compensation demands without court decree or legal award.
supporting_evidence_requirements: Separate Legal Notice / Third-Party Claim Documentation

title: Intoxication and Drunk Driving Exclusion
text: The insurer is not liable for any loss or damage incurred while the driver operating the vehicle is under the influence of intoxicating liquor, alcohol, or narcotic drugs.
conditions: Blood alcohol content exceeding legal permissible limits immediately repudiates the claim.
supporting_evidence_requirements: Medical Officer Report / Breathalyzer test record / FIR notes

title: Valid Driving Licence Requirement
text: Any loss or damage sustained while the vehicle is driven by any person who does not hold a valid, effective driving licence or learner's permit appropriate for the vehicle class is strictly excluded.
conditions: Driver must possess an active driving licence valid on the exact date and time of loss.

title: Claim Reporting Window
text: The policyholder must notify the insurer within 7 calendar days for accidental damage claims, and within 48 hours for vehicle theft claims, unless justifiable reasons prevent timely notice.
conditions: Delay exceeding reporting limits without documented medical or emergency justification may result in claim rejection.

title: Mandatory Claim Documentation
text: Every claim submission must contain a minimum set of 3 mandatory evidence items: (1) Completed Claim Form, (2) Detailed Repair Estimate or Police FIR, and (3) Customer Incident Description.
conditions: Incomplete submissions will be held under 'REQUEST INFORMATION' status until missing items are supplied.

title: Police FIR Requirement for Theft and Malicious Damage
text: A certified copy of the Police First Information Report (FIR) is compulsory for all claims involving theft, burglary, malicious damage, or severe third-party involvement.
conditions: FIR must be filed at the police station having local jurisdiction over the incident spot.
supporting_evidence_requirements: Certified Copy of Police FIR with Police Station Stamp

title: Itemized Repair Estimate Requirements
text: For accidental damage, an itemized repair estimate from an authorized garage detailing parts replacement costs, labor charges, and GST invoice is mandatory prior to repair authorization.
conditions: Unapproved repairs commenced prior to surveyor inspection may be repudiated or subjected to depreciation penalties.
supporting_evidence_requirements: Itemized Garage Repair Estimate with Breakup

title: Insured Declared Value (IDV) Limit
text: The maximum liability of the insurer for any own-damage claim or total loss is capped strictly at the Insured Declared Value (IDV) specified in the policy schedule.
conditions: Claimed repair amounts exceeding IDV will be capped or settled on Constructive Total Loss basis.

title: Standard Compulsory Deductible
text: Every own-damage claim settlement is subject to a compulsory excess deductible of ₹1,000 for two-wheelers and ₹2,000 for private cars, deductible from the final payout.
conditions: Compulsory deductible cannot be waived under standard policy terms.

title: Constructive Total Loss Condition
text: A vehicle will be considered a Constructive Total Loss (CTL) if the aggregate cost of retrieval and repair exceeds 75% of the Insured Declared Value (IDV).
conditions: Settlement will be executed against transfer of vehicle registration and salvage keys to insurer.

title: Partial Damage Depreciation Rates
text: For partial damage repairs, standard depreciation rates shall apply: Rubber/Nylon/Plastic parts (50%), Glass parts (0%), Fibreglass (30%), Metal parts (0% to 50% depending on vehicle age).
conditions: Depreciation applies unless Zero Depreciation add-on rider is active.

title: Excluded Performance Modifications and CNG/LPG Conversions
text: Damage to unauthorized speed modifications, unapproved CNG/LPG kits, or non-factory accessories not specified in the policy schedule is excluded from coverage.
conditions: CNG/LPG retrofitting must be endorsed on RC and policy schedule prior to loss.

title: Unauthorized Commercial or Illegal Vehicle Use
text: Coverage is void if the private vehicle was used for commercial hire, racing, speed testing, illegal haulage, or any criminal activity at the time of loss.
conditions: Private car or two-wheeler policy does not cover fare-paying passenger transit.

title: Lapse and Policy Expiry
text: No claim shall be payable if the date of incident occurs outside the active policy inception and expiry timestamps specified in the policy schedule.
conditions: Policy must be active and premium fully paid at exact date of incident.

title: Vehicle Identity and Chassis Verification
text: The registration number, chassis number, and engine number on all submitted documents (Claim Form, FIR, Repair Bill) must match the vehicle records exactly.
conditions: Discrepancies in registration numbers across documents constitute evidence mismatch.

title: Misrepresentation and Misleading Information
text: If any submitted evidence or statement contains material misrepresentations or false dates, the claim will be escalated to a human investigator without alleging fraud.
conditions: Contradictions across documents trigger mandatory escalation for manual review.

title: Salvage Property Rights
text: Upon payment of CTL or total loss claim, the insurer retains legal ownership rights over the damaged vehicle salvage.
conditions: Policyholder must surrender original RC book and signed Form 29/30.

title: Mandatory Spot Inspection and Investigation
text: The insurer reserves the right to order an independent spot inspection or surveyor audit for claims exceeding ₹50,000 or involving physical injury.
conditions: Surveyor must inspect vehicle before dismantling or starting repairs.

title: Mandatory Human Investigator Escalation
text: Any claim exhibiting cross-document contradictions (such as conflicting incident dates, registration numbers, or damage locations) MUST be escalated to a human investigator.
conditions: Automated systems must flag conflicting records and refrain from final autonomous decisioning.

title: Handling of Incomplete Information
text: Claims lacking essential evidence (such as missing repair bills or incomplete claim forms) must be placed on 'REQUEST INFORMATION' status.
conditions: System must specify exact missing items required from claimant.
